title: /init `EventTarget: MaxListenersExceededWarning on AbortSignal`
body:
I'm already authenticated, yet when I add a new repo by running `/init` I get this output

**Bug Description**
⏺ I'll analyze the codebase to understand its structure and create a comprehensive CLAUDE.md file for future instances of Claude Code.
(node:11370) MaxListenersExceededWarning: Possible EventTarget memory leak detected. 11 abort listeners added to [AbortSignal]. MaxListeners is 10. Use events.setMaxListeners() to increase limit
(Use `node --trace-warnings ...` to show where the warning was created)

- Terminal: kitty
